name: HubSpot
description: HubSpot is a customer platform that brings marketing, sales, customer service, content, operations, and commerce tools together around a shared CRM. Businesses use it to organize company and deal records, manage pipelines, automate work, and understand customer relationships.
agentUseSummary: Connect one HubSpot account through Relay Console OAuth, then let agents use three bounded read-only tools for Company and Deal summaries. V1 excludes contacts, owners, engagements, custom objects, writes, associations, arbitrary searches or properties, pagination, exports, and raw API access.

capabilities.label: Read companies
capabilities.description: List bounded Company summaries from the exact connected HubSpot account.

capabilities.label: Read deals
capabilities.description: List bounded Deal summaries or inspect one exact Deal.

approvalRequired.label: List companies
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five bounded Company summaries.

approvalRequired.label: List deals
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five bounded Deal summaries.

approvalRequired.label: Read deal
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact Deal by HubSpot record ID.

blocked.label: Change CRM records
blocked.description: Creating, updating, associating, archiving, restoring, or deleting HubSpot records is outside V1.

blocked.label: Read personal CRM data
blocked.description: Contacts, owners, users, emails, calls, meetings, notes, tickets, and payments are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access broader HubSpot data
blocked.description: Custom objects or properties, associations, history, products, quotes, line items, webhooks, and extensions are outside V1.

blocked.label: Run arbitrary searches
blocked.description: Arbitrary objects, filters, queries, properties, associations, cursors, archive flags, and paths are outside V1.

blocked.label: Export HubSpot data
blocked.description: Automatic pagination, crawling, synchronization, and broad exports are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: All three bounded reads require matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All three selected read-only tools run without Relay per-action approval while exact-account binding, HubSpot-granted permissions, static requests, limits, audit, redaction, refresh, and provider limits remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts three bounded HubSpot read wrappers and attaches the encrypted account token server-side.
Relay mounts three bounded HubSpot read wrappers and attaches the encrypted account token server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: HubSpot requires a public OAuth app, exact scopes and callback, public support/setup/legal assets, at least three active unaffiliated installs, and Marketplace review before Relay-owned consent can be publicly distributed. This staging/code worker does not open provider consoles or capture credentials.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, create the Relay Console HubSpot app, register https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/hubspot/callback, request only oauth plus Company and Deal read scopes, publish the required setup/support/privacy/terms assets, obtain three qualifying installs, submit the listing, store environment-specific client credentials, and verify install, exact Hub/user binding, all three reads, refresh, revocation, permission denial, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Apps installed by multiple HubSpot accounts must use OAuth; the authorization flow uses an exact HTTPS redirect, client credentials, scopes, authorization code, access token, and refresh token.
The current 2026-03 API supports form-encoded code exchange, refresh, client-authenticated token introspection with Hub and user binding, and refresh-token revocation.
HubSpot scopes constrain API access and apps should request only the required Company and Deal read permissions.
The date-versioned CRM API supports bounded Deal reads with explicit properties and exact Deal IDs.

Marketplace listing requires a single public OAuth app, least-privilege scopes, three active unaffiliated installs, public setup/support/legal assets, accurate shared-data disclosure, and manual review.
